Nick Latshaw, a California native from Northridge, began his insurance career with Chubb Insurance Company in 1992, eventually rising to become a seasoned commercial underwriter. Transitioning to the brokerage side in 2000, he became a Commercial Account Executive and later joined UWIB in 2012, where he excels in serving the Entertainment, Construction, and Non-Profit sectors.

Nick's expertise in these areas is exceptional, further evidenced by his CIC designation earned in the same year, symbolizing his extensive insurance knowledge. He is dedicated to partnering with growing middle-market companies, leveraging his experience from both carrier and agency sides to assist business owners in safeguarding their endeavors. Nick, along with his wife Nikki and their four children, resides in Sierra Madre, where he is deeply ingrained in the community.
